treatment_summary.value: Maternal diet free of milk and derivatives and dairy-free weaning for presumed allergic proctitis (no complete resolution); intravenous methylprednisolone 2 mg/kg daily, then oral betamethasone 0.2 mg/kg daily; oral iron supplementation; anti-inflammatory therapy for panniculitis, then intravenous steroids; then betamethasone 0.1 mg/kg plus anakinra (2 to 6 mg/kg), partial remission; switched to infliximab (5 to 10 mg/kg, weekly then every six weeks) plus methotrexate 7 mg weekly; steroids stopped for side effects; after a relapse two months later, adalimumab (printed as '20 mg/kg every two weeks') plus methotrexate, with good clinical response and complete resolution of skin and gastrointestinal manifestations.

clinical_diagnosis_basis.value: Custom gene panel sequencing including all genes in the IUIS classification identified a heterozygous TNFAIP3 variant (premature stop codon); 'Based on the characteristics of the variant, the genetic diagnosis of A20 haploinsufficiency was established.' Clinical context: early-onset colitis, Behçet-like cutaneous inflammation and positive family history.
